Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Princess Mary of Great Britain, the wife of Frederick II, Landgrave of Hesse-Kassel, as Prince William of Hesse-Kassel's paternal grandmother. This error occurred because WebSurfer relied on the first search result snippet without verifying the information against other credible sources or delving deeper into the hierarchical structure of the genealogical relations. Consequently, WebSurfer conflated Frederick II and Frederick, the father of Prince William, which led to the misidentification of the paternal grandmother as belonging to the wrong generation. This indicates an over-reliance on a single unstructured source of information (e.g., DuckDuckGo search snippets and potentially crowd-sourced platforms) without thorough verification across authoritative or multiple sources.
